name: Awareness
description: Developer library of PHP traits that expose commonly-used Drupal core services through simple protected getter methods, plus a Drush code generator for creating more.
project_description: Awareness is a pure developer-API module. It ships ~47 single-purpose PHP traits (under namespace Drupal\awareness\*) that each add a protected getter method returning a commonly-used Drupal core service via a static \Drupal::service() / \Drupal::<helper>() call. For example, `use Drupal\awareness\Entity\EntityTypeManagerAwareTrait;` gives a class a `$this->getEntityTypeManager()` method. This is a lightweight convenience layer for code that cannot easily use constructor dependency injection (or for rapid prototyping); it is not a substitute for proper DI in services. The module also provides a Drush code generator (`drush generate awareness:trait`, alias `aware`) that scaffolds a new awareness trait for any service registered in the container. It has no routes, permissions, config, entities, blocks, or runtime UI; its only runtime dependency is core File (for the file.repository trait). Use it as a dependency of your own module and `use` the traits you need.
